event_description: Golkar (Airlangga Hartarto), PAN (Zulkifli Hasan) and PPP (Suharso) form a coalition later named Koalisi Indonesia Bersatu (KIB) ahead of 2024
NasDem (Surya Paloh) declares Anies Baswedan its 2024 presidential candidate while still a member of Jokowi's governing coalition
Perindo signs MoU with PDI-P at PDI-P headquarters and declares support for Ganjar Pranowo's 2024 presidential bid
Golkar and PAN, joining Gerindra and PKB, declare support for Prabowo Subianto's 2024 presidential bid (Proclamation Text Formulation Museum, Jakarta)
Demokrat leaves Koalisi Perubahan and withdraws support for Anies after the Anies-Muhaimin pairing; date per Bisnis report of SBY meeting (exact announcement date to recheck)
NasDem and PKB declare Anies Baswedan and Muhaimin Iskandar as presidential/VP pair in Surabaya; PKB moves from Prabowo camp to Anies camp
Golkar Rapimnas (chair Airlangga Hartarto) endorses Gibran Rakabuming Raka as Prabowo's running mate; Prabowo announces Gibran on 2023-10-22
After the Constitutional Court upheld the result, Surya Paloh meets Prabowo and declares NasDem's support for the incoming Prabowo-Gibran government (PKB declared support shortly before)
Angela Tanoesoedibjo succeeds founder Hary Tanoesoedibjo as Perindo General Chair
Airlangga Hartarto announces resignation as Golkar chairman (effective night of 2024-08-10)
Perindo chair Angela Tanoesoedibjo meets Prabowo and declares Perindo joins the Prabowo-Gibran camp, leaving PDI-P's alliance; says no ministerial posts requested
Bahlil Lahadalia elected Golkar chairman unopposed at national congress
NasDem High Council re-elects Surya Paloh as chairman for 2024-2029 (congress opened by Jokowi 2024-08-25)
PKS Majelis Syura chair Salim Segaf Al-Jufri announces PKS joins the Prabowo government
NasDem says it will not take cabinet posts but remains in the government's ranks (no opposition), per deputy chair Saan Mustopa

Red and White Cabinet announced; Golkar is the largest coalition contingent after Gerindra (incl. Airlangga Hartarto, Bahlil Lahadalia); Perindo gets a deputy minister (Veronica Tan); NasDem and PDI-P have no ministers
Reshuffle: Mukhtarudin (Golkar) becomes Minister of Migrant Workers' Protection; Dito Ariotedjo (Golkar) leaves Youth and Sports, replaced by Erick Thohir on 2025-09-17
At NasDem's 14th anniversary Surya Paloh reaffirms the party is among those supporting the Prabowo-Gibran government
Muhammad Sarmuji (Golkar) replaces Agus Gumiwang Kartasasmita as Minister of Industry; Bahlil Lahadalia also made Coordinating Minister for Downstreaming and Energy Transition
